body_html:
The Chevron Ultra medium-back multi-tilter chair pairs a contoured, supportive back with a full suite of ergonomic adjustments, so each user can dial in the fit that keeps them comfortable through a long workday. It is a confident, value-minded task chair for private offices, school-board and municipal workspaces, and busy administrative floors. Built in Canada by Global Furniture Group, it is also OECM-eligible, so Ontario institutional buyers can purchase without an open tender.

Features

  • Soft Descent pneumatic seat-height adjustment for smooth, controlled positioning
  • Seat depth adjustment plus independent seat and back angle control
  • Infinitely adjustable seat angle and adjustable back angle
  • 5-1/4" of back-height adjustment to align lumbar support to the user
  • Tilt tension adjustment to match recline resistance to body weight
  • Height- and width-adjustable arms with articulating arm caps
  • Hard-floor casters on a durable five-star base

Specifications

Upholstered fabric seat and back over moulded foam, rated to a 300 lb weight capacity with an 18"-wide x 16"-deep seat. Covered by Global Furniture Group's 2-year warranty on upholstery, foam and moving mechanisms (Offices To Go value-catalog terms) under single-shift use.

Looking to outfit a full floor or standardize seating across sites? Request a Quote for volume pricing and finish options, or call Brant Business Interiors at 1-800-835-9565.
